factual_accuracy_review.scope: Independent verification of every technical claim in this file against tools/aris_homepage.py source, skills/homepage-generator/SKILL.md, skills/homepage-generator/PROFILE_SCHEMA.md, and README.md's ARIS-Homepage section (audited jointly with docs/aris-homepage-windows-quickstart_CN.md in the same thread since both describe the same tool). findings.claim: "DBLP/arXiv fact-checking only verifies that a title/venue/year/author combination is correct"
findings.correction: run_fact_check() (tools/aris_homepage.py ~L1373-1493) never checks author lists — only bibkey existence, DBLP title match, year mismatch, venue mismatch, and award-badge URL sanity.

findings.claim: "[Paper]/[Code]/[Slides] links only render if you put them yourself in publications.bib (url/eprint fields) or profile.yml's publications_meta.<bibkey>.links"
findings.correction: build_publications_section() (tools/aris_homepage.py ~L904-986, esp. L928-958 and L978-982) reads links EXCLUSIVELY from profile.yml's publications_meta.<bibkey>.links — a url/eprint field in publications.bib is valid BibTeX but is never consumed for rendering link buttons.

rounds.confirmed_claims_summary: Script filename/underscore (no installed aris-homepage command), the four-command pipeline (init -> agent fills extraction.json -> finalize -> render --persona theory-minimal) matching cmd_init/print_extraction_handoff/cmd_finalize, finalize's clear die() when extraction.json is missing, theory-minimal valid / active-researcher hard-disabled (PERSONAS + cmd_render), identity.photo local-base64/remote-URL embed with no fetching (build_photo_html), and the Windows-environment claims (.py file-association silence being external/not script-suppressed, python3 App Execution Alias stub, non-ASCII pdftotext path mangling as an external poppler-build limitation consistent with pdftotext being invoked as a subprocess arg, and CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED being consistent with the DBLP fetch path using urllib.request.urlopen, confirmed in dblp_search_title) — all CONFIRMED against source. One additional nuance surfaced (not an error in this file): cmd_finalize supports --out to target another workspace, cmd_render does not (always operates on cwd) — this file's examples already `cd` into the site dir before every command, so no fix was required for this point specifically.

rounds.notes: Targeted fixes for the two WRONG findings above were correct, but the closing sentence of the 'Your first CV-only site...' section still told users to add missing links/images in both profile.yml AND publications.bib — over-broad given the link-source finding.

Follow-up sentence tightened to point at profile.yml's publications_meta (links/thumbnail per bibkey) only. Reviewer re-read both audited files fresh from disk and confirmed no remaining issue from the audited claim set.

maintainer_review.why: The contributor's own gpt-5.4 audit was real work and caught two genuine overclaims, but it did not re-derive the audit verdict semantics or the Windows dependency chain. A maintainer pass against tools/aris_homepage.py found further errors and moved the files out of docs/.
corrections_landed: A fact-check hard failure yields verdict BLOCKED and `render` exits WITHOUT writing index.html — the guide had said the result only affects marks in the audit report (aris_homepage.py:1364-1371, :682).
`.docx` was recommended as the no-pdftotext fallback; on Windows it needs `python-docx` (textutil is macOS-only). `.txt` is the only zero-install format (:496-506).
Both conda examples were unrunnable: `render` treats cwd as the workspace, so from the site dir the script path must be `..\tools\aris_homepage.py` (:671).
The English edition billed itself as a tested sequence but never installed `pyyaml` and opened with a `.pdf` needing poppler (:619, :512).
The error table quoted pdftotext's `I/O Error`, which `capture_output=True, check=True` swallows — the user sees an uncaught CalledProcessError instead (:509, :340).
Python 3.10+ (the floor declared in SKILL.md) was not stated; the guide accepted any version.
Fact-check scope corrected: DBLP only (ARXIV_API is defined but never called), only `selected_publications` entries, no author check, award sanity accepts only 5 link fields.
The two editions are now faithful siblings; each previously carried facts the other omitted.
maintainer_review.relocated: docs/ is published verbatim by pages.yml with no Jekyll, so a .md there ships as raw markdown, docs/aris-homepage-windows/ would 404, and ../skills ../tools links would break on the site. The guides now sit beside the skill they document and are linked from README, README_CN and SKILL.md.
not_done_deliberately: No hashes re-stamped: the original `source_sha256` fields were dropped rather than refreshed. Nothing consumes them outside docs/, and tools/verify_reviews.py only walks docs/**/*.html.
No render pipeline entry, manifest row, CI check or test was added for these two files — they are read on GitHub, next to SKILL.md, like PROFILE_SCHEMA.md.
Reviewer proposals declined as out-of-scope for a first-run Windows guide: expired-per-paper-override BLOCKED path, and the nuance that PASS can occur with zero selected papers.
